argv:
set -u
printf '__IDENT_PRE__\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id || exit 91
cat /proc/uptime || exit 91
cat /proc/4958/stat || exit 91
cat /proc/4958/cmdline || exit 91
printf '\n'
printf '__HILOG_BEGIN__\n'
hilog -P 4958 -z 2000 -L D,I,W,E,F -v epoch
r=$?
printf '__HILOG_RC__=%s\n' "$r"
printf '__IDENT_POST__\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id || exit 92
cat /proc/uptime || exit 92
cat /proc/4958/stat || exit 92
cat /proc/4958/cmdline || exit 92
printf '\n__END__\n'
exit "$r"

host_runner.mode: stream both pipes; never unbounded capture_output; stop local HDC client at first deadline or byte cap; no device process kill
host_runner.timeout_or_cap: preserve received bytes and actual local return code; mark partial and missing postguard UNKNOWN; no retry

interpretation: Reject normal-success classification if CODE error/unrecognized/usage appears even with rc0.
Compare complete pre/post boot and stat field22 plus cmdline org.westlake.imehost; missing fields or PID reuse means UNKNOWN, not discard raw.
No -x; tail2000 is historical bounded lines, not 10 seconds of log coverage. Report actual first/last epoch and whether click interval is included.
WL_IME_HOST event=foreground is observed callback evidence; stage-event details.event retain numeric values without assigning undocumented meaning.

child22035 start ticks6535369 / CLK_TCK100 = 65353.69 seconds since boot, not epoch. Use same-boot uptime/epoch anchor and recorded click interval; host/device clock offset remains unknown unless measured.
No fresh click or process-state modification. No new feed claim.
